scientific_integrity: Analytical derivation covers the entire infinite family. Exact finite enumeration covers all simple labeled graphs through five vertices, and independent permutation enumeration checks the recurrence. No statistical sampling substitutes for exhaustive verification.
scientific_limitations: Universal likelihood-ratio assertion is restricted to graphs on at most five vertices. The infinite join family gives first-order-but-not-likelihood-ratio behavior; no general larger-graph classification is asserted. The complete small-graph certificate is computationally finite and inspectable; no external mathematical audit has been done.
title: Sharp six-vertex failure of likelihood-ratio domination in graph parking
